title: SparseTokenGS: Gaussian-based Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction via Reusable Token Pool
abstract: arXiv:2610.38360v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography is widely used for fast, low-dose volumetric imaging and lesion localization in dentistry and image-guided interventions, but it introduces severe artifacts. Feed-forward Gaussian methods transfer the reconstruction cost to training and decode each coordinate from projection-aligned features and neighboring anchors. However, information from the whole scan is written only when the field is constructed and cannot be retrieved during coordinate decoding, leaving the volume inconsistent within the scan. This is a common limitation of such methods: once the field is fixed, decoding uses only local features and reconstruction quality drops substantially. We propose SparseTokenGS, a Gaussian-based method for sparse-view cone-beam computed tomography reconstruction via a reusable token pool. Anchor Token Fusion and Point-Token Attention query this shared pool at the anchors and at the query coordinate

translated_title: SparseTokenGS：基于可复用令牌池的高斯稀疏视角CBCT重建
translated_abstract: 稀疏视角锥束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）广泛用于牙科和图像引导介入中的快速、低剂量体积成像与病灶定位，但会引入严重的伪影。前馈高斯方法将重建成本转移到训练阶段，并通过投影对齐特征和邻近锚点来解码每个坐标。然而，来自整个扫描的信息仅在场构建时写入，无法在坐标解码过程中检索，导致体积在扫描内部不一致。这是此类方法的普遍局限：一旦场被固定，解码仅使用局部特征，重建质量会大幅下降。我们提出SparseTokenGS，一种通过可复用令牌池实现稀疏视角锥束CT重建的基于高斯的方法。锚点令牌融合和点令牌注意力机制在锚点处和查询坐标处查询这一共享池。
tldr: 提出SparseTokenGS，通过可复用令牌池及锚点令牌融合与点令牌注意力机制，使坐标解码阶段能够检索全局扫描信息，从而解决稀疏视角CBCT重建中场固定后仅依赖局部特征导致质量下降的问题。
en_tdlr: SparseTokenGS introduces a reusable token pool with Anchor Token Fusion and Point-Token Attention, enabling global information retrieval during coordinate decoding to overcome the quality degradation caused by local-feature-only decoding in sparse-view CBCT reconstruction.
